featureAssessments.rationale: Zero cards were produced (itemsCount=0) and no sample guidance is available, so diagnostics currently adds neither a local fix nor clarity about why a section needs work.
The review logged 6 factCheckRows but no actionable recommendations or local anchors, so editors see limited practical use beyond reassuring that the claims were reviewed.

Seven structure cards plus the rewrite/list/subsection/callout actions all produce concrete text diffs (e.g., grouping symptom lists, adding subheadings) that respect local context and preserve meaning, so they drive high-value edits.
Eleven clarity cards focus on tonality and simplification; the simplify/rewrite actions for the intro and symptom tone have clean diffs with manageable risk, giving practical editorial value.
Interest cards surface expansion opportunities (e.g., explaining ectoderm or itch mechanisms) that inspire local additions with clear purpose, and the expand action delivered a targeted paragraph.
Fifteen suggestions advocate infographics (signal maps, antioxidant plates) but no tangible drafts or diffs are provided, so the value depends on manual follow-up rather than automatic edits.
Formatting cards reiterate tonality issues and callout needs (e.g., explaining ectoderm) but largely overlap with clarity/final-editing, limiting unique impact despite low noise.
Nine final-editing cards reinforce rewrites/simplifications (intro tone, skin-color section) and align with existing text diffs, helping editors polish wording without altering meaning.

actionAssessments.rationale: The rewrite action distilled the intro metaphors into a tighter passage with a full text_diff (4 blocks) while keeping the local framing, so it is practical and low risk.
Simplify trimmed a poetic intro for faster entry, again via text_diff on the same block range, which preserves meaning while lowering reading friction.
Expand added a short explanation of how toxins irritate nerve endings behind itching (blocks p-32, list-33, p-34), delivering high editorial value with precise scope.
Consolidating the epigenetics mini-headings into a single block via list_replace reduces noise and aligns with the goal of local, meaningful restructuring.
The proposed subsection draft adds a clear second-level heading for nails and hair before the anchor h-35, helping editors insert structure without rewriting the accompanying copy.
The mechanism callout about senolytics provides a focused explanation and preview text while staying within the existing context, offering high editorial lift with minimal risk.

topImprovements.description: Surface a diagnostics status message even when no cards appear so editors know which passages were scanned and why no issues were flagged.
Tie fact-check rows to explicit anchors/recommendations (callouts or inline notes) so the verification work can guide local edits instead of appearing as invisible metadata.
Generate lightweight placeholders or previews for visual-card suggestions (e.g., template titles + brief captions) to make it easier for editors to act on infographics without designing from scratch.
Deduplicate clarity, formatting, and final-editing cards by clustering their shared tonality/medical-tone signals so editors see one consolidated recommendation per fragment.
Expose action reliability metadata (confidence, sample reason) per suggestion to help editors triage rewrite/simplify/expand proposals when multiple actions target the same passage.
